plugin.note: Turoths have the leafy attribute and can only be damaged by leaf-bladed weapons, broad ammunition, or Magic Dart. Protect from Melee negates all of their damage.

requirements: 55 Slayer and 60 combat are required for Turoth assignments.
Use only leaf-bladed weapons, broad-tipped ammunition, or Magic Dart for damage.
Bigger and Badder unlocks Spiked Turoth superior spawns.
mechanics: Turoths attack with stab and can hit up to 9.
Protect from Melee negates all Turoth damage.
The leafy attribute restricts damage to leaf-bladed weapons, broad-tipped ammunition, or Magic Dart.
Spiked Turoth has no special mechanics, but is more accurate and has a max hit of 29.

methods.label: Damage restrictions
methods.summary: Respect the leafy damage restriction: only leaf-bladed weapons, broad ammunition, or Magic Dart can damage Turoths.
steps: Equip a leaf-bladed weapon, a bow or crossbow using broad ammunition, or a Magic Dart setup.
Do not bring ordinary weapons or spells as the main damage source.
notes: The task page compares this restriction to Kurasks.

methods.label: Leaf-bladed melee
methods.summary: Use leaf-bladed battleaxe for high melee damage, or leaf-bladed sword/spear when unavailable.
steps: Use the leaf-bladed battleaxe over the sword or spear for its higher max hit.
Pray Protect from Melee for the lowest-attention setup, or tank the inaccurate stab attacks with decent armour.

methods.label: Broad ammunition ranged
methods.summary: Use broad bolts or broad arrows with ranged gear when safespotting or training Ranged.
requiredOrKeyItems: Broad bolts or Amethyst broad bolts
steps: Use broad bolts with a crossbow or broad arrows with a compatible bow.
Use the dungeon's safespots to avoid all damage.
Do not switch to non-broad ammunition because it will not damage Turoths.

methods.label: Magic Dart
methods.summary: Cast Magic Dart with a Slayer's staff or staff of the dead, ideally from a safespot.
requiredOrKeyItems: Slayer's staff or Staff of the dead
steps: Equip a staff that can cast Magic Dart.
Cast Magic Dart from a safespot for damage-free kills.

methods.label: Spiked Turoth superior
methods.summary: Handle Spiked Turoth as a stronger superior with no special mechanics, using Protect from Melee and a valid leafy damage source.
requiredOrKeyItems: Leaf-bladed battleaxe or valid broad/Magic Dart setup
steps: Turn on Protect from Melee when Spiked Turoth spawns.
Continue using leaf-bladed weapons, broad ammunition, or Magic Dart.
Expect higher accuracy and a max hit of 29, but no additional mechanics.

methods.label: Inventory and loot
methods.summary: Bring an Herb sack and alch runes because Turoths drop herbs frequently alongside seeds and alchables.
inventory: Leaf-bladed battleaxe or broad ammunition setup
steps: Bring an Herb sack for the frequent herb drops.
Pick up seeds and alchable drops as desired.

styleOptions.label: Leaf-bladed melee
styleOptions.summary: Primary melee setup using leaf-bladed battleaxe.

styleOptions.label: Broad ammunition ranged
styleOptions.summary: Ranged setup using broad bolts or broad arrows.

styleOptions.label: Magic Dart
styleOptions.summary: Magic option using Magic Dart, one of the few valid ways to damage Turoths.

body:
# Turoth

Turoths have the leafy attribute and can only be damaged by leaf-bladed weapons, broad ammunition, or Magic Dart. Use leaf-bladed battleaxe melee, broad ammunition ranged, or Magic Dart; Protect from Melee negates all of their damage, and the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon offers plentiful safespots.
